required_opencode_environment.scope: OpenCode server process and standalone CLI process

company_action_required: Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1 and OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH=1 on the actual OpenCode CLI/server process; keep public webfetch/websearch denied; have the security/network owner supply the exact approved intranet/model/package endpoints and deploy an OS/network firewall allowlist plus an attempt monitor. Desktop updater behavior is separate and must be independently disabled or network-blocked. The environment variables and project permissions are not an OS firewall.
